Players Committee card image of [[Nizuc Bek (V)]] (Virtual Block 3, Dark, slip 16): the slip printed over the Decipher Jabba's Palace card [[Nizuc Bek]].

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/legacy/VirtualBlock3-Dark/large/nizucbek.gif nizucbek.gif], Players Committee card image (Virtual Block 3, Dark) at res.starwarsccg.org. The wiki file has the same bytes (SHA-1 3fc4ac32b8dd6e71ddd88edd03fd66d228836bba, 350×490). Text matches the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 3 release sheet] (7 December 2009), slip 16, margin “•Nizuk Bek (V)”.
